title: Differential compatibility of a degreewise stalk tensor comparison
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $x\in X$, and $T$ its additive module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Let $\varphi_{A,B}:T(A\otimes B)\cong T(A)\otimes T(B)$ be natural in both module sheaves. Suppose degreewise isomorphisms $e_{F,K,n}:T(\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes K)^n)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(TF\otimes TK)^n$ are given for all cochain complexes $F,K$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with $T(\iota_{p,q})e_{F,K,n}=\varphi_{F^p,K^q}\iota_{p,q}$ for every $p+q=n$. Then $e_{F,K,n}d_{TF,TK}^{n,m}=T(d_{F,K}^{n,m})e_{F,K,m}$ for all $n,m$, with the total tensor differentials [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves].

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma Tag 06YB (label lemma-check-K-flat-stalks), tensor-stalk identification

proof.text: Conjugate by e and use coproduct hom-ext and the component tensor isomorphisms to reduce equality to every stalked summand injection. Extend the injection formula to zero injections by a case split on the degree condition.

Use the signed horizontal/vertical differential formulas of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Additivity preserves their sum and integer signs. Tensor naturality applied to the first differential and identity, then identity and the second differential, identifies the two parts.
